# vosk-browser 0.0.8

Offline speech recognition in the browser (a WebAssembly build of
[Vosk](https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api)), copied unchanged from the npm
package [`vosk-browser@0.0.8`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vosk-browser)
(`dist/vosk.js`). Licensed under the Apache License 2.0 by Ciaran O'Reilly.

The English model it uses lives in `models/` and is downloaded by the
`Fetch offline speech model` GitHub Actions workflow.
